links.explanation: Both reports state that a 60 mph speed limit is inappropriate for the road environment and poses a risk of future deaths. They differ in the specific road and surrounding features discussed.
links.earlier_quote: During the course of the evidence my attention was drawn to the fact that the road is only subject to the statutory limit of 6Omph whilst it has residential properties at places along its length, a busy petrol station and large fay-by southbound and a busy hotel northbound on joining the A519 upon leaving the M6 at junction 15.
links.later_quote: The rural, unlit road is governed by the national speed limit of 60 mph and narrows in both directions at the point of the bridge.
